codes.title: Attendance codes
codes.subtitle: Attendance code catalogue (X, P, Ô, TS, L, CT, WFH, KL, V…) and the result category handed to payroll.
codes.globalHelp: Platform default codes cannot be changed.

exception.CODE_NOT_APPLIED_OFF_DAY: Code not applied on a day off

grid.title: Timesheets
grid.subtitle: Daily timesheets of a legal entity / org unit. Days are recomputed from their inputs, never edited: adjustments with a reason are applied on every calculation.
grid.empty: No timesheet days in this range.
grid.limitHint: At most {limit, number} rows per page.

recompute.title: Recompute timesheets
recompute.help: Recomputes the days in the range for the legal entity or the selected employees. Days of closed / locked periods are not changed.
recompute.done: Recomputed: {written, number} updated, {unchanged, number} unchanged, {frozen, number} frozen, {skipped, number} skipped.

edit.title: Adjust timesheet
edit.help: Set a code and / or the in and out times. The adjustment is kept with its reason and applied on every recalculation.
edit.timesOneDay: In / out times can only be set when all selected days share one work date.
edit.nextDay: An out time before the in time means the next day.
edit.codeOrTime: Choose a code or enter the in / out times.

correction.title: Request a correction for {date}
correction.help: The request goes through the approval workflow; once approved, the day is recomputed.

employee.title: Employee timesheet
employee.subtitle: Daily timesheets, raw punches, correction requests and menstrual-break declarations of one employee.
employee.totals: Total: {days, number} days · {hours, number} worked hours
employee.punchesAudited: Reading raw punches is recorded in the audit log.

day.title: Timesheet of {date}
day.notComputed: This day has not been computed yet.

menstrual.title: Menstrual-period break
menstrual.help: Female workers get a 30-minute break per day, up to the statutory number of days per month. Declarations need no approval; the day is recomputed.
menstrual.sensitive: Sensitive data: reading it is recorded in the audit log.

warning.eligibility-gender-unverified: The employee's gender could not be verified.

errors.platform-code: Platform default codes cannot be changed.
errors.invalid-code: The code takes upper-case letters, digits and '_' (at most 10).
errors.invalid-payroll-category: The result category takes upper-case letters and '_'.
errors.code-on-non-working-day: The code does not apply on a day off.
errors.code-or-time-required: Choose a code or enter the in / out times.
errors.correction-limit-reached: The monthly limit of correction requests is reached.
errors.day-frozen: The day belongs to a closed or locked attendance period.
errors.future-day: A future day cannot be corrected.
errors.times-incomplete: Enter both the in and the out time.
errors.times-single-day: In / out times apply to one work date only.
errors.time-outside-day: The time is outside the work day.
errors.target-required: Choose a legal entity or employees.
errors.employment-not-in-scope: You have no access to this employee.
errors.monthly-limit-reached: The monthly number of days is already declared.
errors.not-eligible-gender: This break applies to female workers.
errors.too-far-ahead: A day can be declared at most 31 days ahead.
errors.legal-parameter-missing: A required legal parameter is missing.
